mentions.name: The Lounge
mentions.description: A self-hostable, web-based IRC client. The project is being modernized in two ways: migrating to new JavaScript tooling (webpack to Vite, Node's built-in SQLite) and adopting IRCv3 features like emoji reactions, threaded replies, and typing indicators, with an active community IRC channel and an easy contribution path.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on modernizing https://thelounge.chat, a self-hostable web based IRC client
